title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SKillCompiler, a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operation

translated_title: 编译消除不确定性：通过程序化编译实现自进化的智能体技能
translated_abstract: 自进化的智能体技能使AI智能体能够从交互经验中积累和精炼可复用的程序性知识，而无需更新模型参数。然而，由于这类技能通常以文本文档的形式表示，并通过LLM推理来执行，即使是之前已经学习过的程序也必须被反复解释和重新生成，这给每次执行引入了本可避免的不确定性。相比之下，程序执行是确定性的且可独立验证的。直观地说，将明确定义的操作转化为可执行程序可以减少对LLM推理的依赖，从而降低执行的不确定性。受此启发，我们提出了SkillCompiler，一个将程序化编译集成到技能进化过程中的自进化技能框架。具体而言，SkillCompiler采用一种可执行性感知的技能编译策略，将技能分解为细粒度的操作
tldr: SkillCompiler是一个自进化技能框架，通过可执行性感知的编译策略将技能中明确定义的操作程序化编译为可执行代码，减少对LLM反复推理的依赖，从而消除智能体技能执行中的不确定性。
en_tdlr: SkillCompiler is a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into skill evolution, using an executability-aware compilation strategy to transform well-specified skill operations into executable programs, thereby reducing reliance on repeated LLM reasoning and eliminating execution uncertainty in agent skills.
